description: The double-cart lab rig: the motor, gearbox, pulley, belt and cart of pendulum-double-cart with two 0.35 m links built from aluminium tubes with clamp hubs, a bearing head, encoders and a cable (0.248 / 0.200 kg, centres of mass 0.229 / 0.176 m) on a +-1.0 m rail with soft end stops; all values from design/realism.json. 1 kHz firmware (library/DoubleCartLabCtrl.jl with the tables of library/DoubleCartLabTraj.jl, written by design/design.py): 0 V until 1 s, a direct-collocation swing-up (T_s = 3.0 s, planned inside |x| <= 0.8 m and |V| <= 16.8 V = 70 % of 24 V) tracked by a time-varying LQR, the discrete LQR from 4.0 s and a 40 ms tip push at 7.5 s; the balance model starts leaning 2 deg and takes a larger push at 2 s; the -free model releases the plant from rest with the motor shorted and is compared with the design ODE. The reference numbers are design.py's closed loop of the design model under the same sampled firmware.
